name: Global Type Declarations
description: Global type declarations for the renderer process. Defines Window.electronAPI interface with all IPC namespaces (window, clipboard, terminal, workspace, shell, prefs, git, fs, ide), plus EditorState, WorkspaceState, DirEntry, and EditorSelectionState interfaces.

types.name: EditorState
types.description: Editor tab state: openFiles, activeFile, explorerWidth, cursors per file

types.name: WorkspaceState
types.description: Serialized workspace: plugins[], zOrder[], zoom, panX, panY, locked

types.name: EditorSelectionState
types.description: IDE context selection: filePath, text, selection range

test: src/global.d.ts (no dedicated test; types tested via consumer tests)
